sp: Create a professional and visually appealing video summary infographic poster. The design should be modern, clean, and information-rich. Design Requirements: Style - Modern infographic poster with a professional look; Layout - Clear visual hierarchy with a prominent title area at the top, key points displayed in organized sections with icons or visual markers, and a summary section at the bottom; Color Scheme - Use a harmonious and professional color palette; Typography - Bold, readable titles with clear section headers; Visual Elements - Include relevant icons, dividers, and decorative elements to enhance readability; Text should be in Chinese (Simplified); High contrast for readability; Include visual indicators like numbered points, bullet icons, or section dividers. The final image should look like a professionally designed video summary card that can be shared on social media or used as a quick reference.
